title: The Plane Ride
content: I’ve dreamt about an airport world & traveling on planes many times. The other night I had an insanely vivid airport / plane dream that blows all my previous ones out of the sky (literally). I was taking a last minute random trip “out west” with a handful of my coworkers. We arrived at the airport and I had minimal luggage. Like I’m talking just a small purse filled with crumpled receipts and dollar bills. I couldn’t find my license which somehow wasn’t a big deal. I managed to pull up something on my phone (legit I think it was a Michael’s craft store coupon) and the airline employee scanned it and I was good to go. Just like any other dream where I’m traveling, I feel completely unprepared and anxious. My coworker eased my stress by telling me she had plenty of money on her and I could “borrow one of her bathing suits”. The airport was like a crowded high school cafeteria. We stood in lines as if we were about to tray up a lunch. There was an upstairs level (stainless steel walls, not very colorful) which had a few food courts. There was a sandwich shop that had sandwiches rolling on a futuristic vertical conveyer belt. When we boarded the plane, we passed the pilot in the front and made our way to the back 3 rows. These rows were facing the opposite direction-towards the back of the plane. But to my surprise, there was another pilot in front of us facing the same way (looking out the back through a small window). When we took off, I realized we were moving forward which confused me. Takeoff seemed very rushed. The pilot near us barely had his door closed before we were in the air. I observed the pilot and the interior of the plane with great detail. Suddenly, it looked like the inside of a school bus. There was a lever to open the door, there was a large mirror for the pilot to view passengers. The pilot seemed very scatterbrained and was having a casual conversation with one of my coworkers. I noticed when he took his hand off the wheel, the plane would jerk or dip low.. but he would immediately correct it to make us steady again. The whole ride felt very unsafe and it was as if everyone was aware of how risky this plane ride was but we were OK with taking our chances. (Cheap airline ticketsss baby) I remember looking out my giant window as we hovered very close to the ground. But we were making great timing- crossing over states like it was nothing. We left from PA (where I live IRL) and I can recall the pilot saying “yep this is Ohio and now we’re in Indiana.. now Nebraska” like within a matter of seconds. We reached one beautiful region that was sprawling with colorful mountains. I remember being in awe looking at the fields of flowers and crystal blue streams of water. We dipped in an out of mountain ranges. When we made it to our destination (somewhere on the west coast) we exited the plane only to find ourselves back at my parents house in PA 😂 but we treated it as an air bnb. Everything felt normal- I wasn’t even questioning the absurdity of it all. I felt relieved because I had clothes I could wear since I didn’t pack any; I rummaged through my old closet at my parents. We all got changed into our bathing suits and walked my old neighborhood to find the “beach”- lol like what? The Delaware river? I woke up before we made it there.
